```bash
# Confirm docs/ops emptiness / redirects; fix import examples; check AGENTS overlap
ls -la docs/ops 2>&1; ls -la docs/agents/ops | head -15
echo "=== import path checks ==="
rg -n "from '@/features/agents/prometheus'|from \"@/features/agents/prometheus\"" apps/app --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' | head -5
rg -n "from '@repo/ai'|from \"@repo/ai\"" apps/app --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' | head -5
rg -n "DataVizComponent" apps/app --glob '*.{ts,tsx}' | head -5
test -f apps/app/src/features/agents/prometheus.tsx && echo features/agents/prometheus EXISTS || echo features/agents/prometheus MISSING
test -f apps/app/src/services/ai/agents/prometheus.tsx && echo services path EXISTS
echo "=== packages/ai package name ==="
head -5 packages/ai/package.json 2>/dev/null
echo "=== docs README ops pointer ==="
rg -n "docs/ops|docs/agents/ops" docs/README.md | head -15
echo "=== autonomous loop in CLAUDE? ==="
rg -n "GOAL.md|/loop|/goal" CLAUDE.md || echo "missing from CLAUDE"
echo "=== spacetime feature brief existence ==="
test -f docs/plans/2026-08-01-spacetime-canvas-implementation.md && echo OK spacetime plan
test -f docs/vision/TEMPORAL_OBSERVATORY.md && echo OK temporal observatory
echo "=== bun from root ==="
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log('test:app', p.scripts['test:app']); console.log('dev:app', p.scripts['dev:app'])"
```
